records.source_statement: Saturn, Mars or retrograde/combust planet in first is linked to quarrels attributed to querent; seventh-house counterpart blamed when likewise afflicted.
limitations: Affected first versus seventh must be maintained.

records.source_statement: Moon in fall or in square/opposition to Saturn/Mars/retrograde planet and beholding ascendant is used to allege disputes moved by woman.
Third-house lord afflicting parties is read as kin/brothers causing strife.
An infortune in tenth is taken as brawling and wrangling in the author's scheme.
